overview_description.description: Loop provides a platform that manages logistics and supply chain data through automation and analytics tools. The system aggregates shipment, carrier, and financial data into a unified interface to support visibility and coordination. It includes features for freight audit, payment processing, and cost tracking across transportation activities. The platform also supports issue resolution, reporting, and performance monitoring for carriers and shipments. Loop serves organizations that require structured data handling and process automation within logistics operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Loop provides a platform that manages logistics and supply chain data through automation and analytics tools.

product.name: Loop Logistics Data Platform
product.description: A logistics data platform that unifies shipment, carrier, contract, invoice, and tracking data to automate transportation operations and support analytics across freight and parcel networks.

product.name: Freight and Parcel Audit
product.description: Automated auditing for freight and parcel invoices that checks charges against contracts, shipment records, and expected rates to identify discrepancies, recover credits, and reduce overpayments.

product.name: Real-Time Visibility
product.description: Shipment and carrier performance visibility across transportation networks, with tracking data, delivery monitoring, and alerts for potential delays or exceptions.

product.name: Parcel Contract Optimization
product.description: Analytics and advisory services for evaluating parcel carrier contracts, discounts, rates, service levels, and network choices to reduce transportation spend.

product.name: Loop Intelligence
product.description: Logistics analytics and decision-support capabilities that provide financial, carrier, and network insights through dashboards, custom reports, alerts, and natural-language analysis.

product.name: Carrier Payments
product.description: Carrier invoice payment workflows that support invoice approval, payment execution, payment-term management, and options such as quick pay for transportation partners.
